## History

Spencer was visited by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to address a mix-up regarding Anne's adoption. During the visit, Mrs. [Blewett](../character/peter-blewett.md) offered to take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in as a servant, prompting [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to hesitate and take [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back home instead.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P20](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0020), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031)_

## Relationships

### [Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/flora-jane--spencer.md)

[Flora Jane](../character/flora-jane.md) is the child of Mrs. Spencer. Her mother was involved in arranging the adoption mix-up that brought [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of the boy that [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) had originally requested.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P4](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P18](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0018), +2 more_
